estimates.note: For our own reference, quotes gathered before choosing a pool company. This section is separate from the build stages and does not count toward progress.

companies.name: Dreamescape Pools and Spas, First Visit
companies.notes: First company we contacted and didn't go with this because it was out of budget

companies.name: Kura Design Pools
companies.notes: Pool (20x30) with sunshelf and spa.  Acrylic decking (not whole deck) with footer for future screen enclosure.

companies.name: Premier Pools of Central Florida
companies.notes: Pool, spa, footer deck and screen.

companies.name: Dunota Pool Construction
companies.notes:
Price is only for pool (15x30) with spa. 
Asked for acrylic deck which would be 16K.
 Screen is another 27K.
For a total of $120.132
Seems like having a pool is out of our budget 😟

companies.name: Dreamescape Pools and Spas, Second Visit
companies.notes:
Pool, spa, acrylic deck and screen for 105K.  We asked for heating water circulation which added an extra 3K. Illustration does not show the screen surrounding the pool.
This is different from what we first wanted, but functionality wise, this worked better for us.

estimates.decision:
We chose Dreamscape for several reasons.
1. Jay was very helpful, he listened to what we were looking for in a pool and he gave suggestions based on our interest.  We ended up with a pool different from our original design.
2. It was the closest to our 100K budget for pool, spa, deck and screened enclosure. Decision made on 2026-05-18

Our budget: 
* 70K for pool and spa
* 10k for deck
* 20K for screen enclosure.

fenceEstimates.note:
The fence quote covers an upside down L-shaped layout. The left side has 1 gate, and the right side (near the garage) has 2 gates.
We noticed some fences around the neighborhood were sagging at the bottom, so we were advised to add reinforcement at the inner base of the fence to prevent that. We got quotes from several fence companies that had already installed fences in the neighborhood, so we'd know they were reliable and could deliver what we needed

companies.name: Eric Fence
companies.notes: Did not come with steel reinforcement.

companies.name: Mossy Oaks Fence
companies.notes: Does have reinforcement at the bottom but will continue to look around.

companies.name: Big Woody Fence
companies.notes: Does not come with steel reinforcement and will still check around.

companies.name: Signature Fence
companies.notes: This comes with standard fence for 7,449 but if we want reinforcement at the bottom that's 8,247. Meh..

companies.name: J&B Fence
companies.notes: We picked this company with the reinforcement.

fenceEstimates.decision: We chose J&B Fence for the value, though their slow communication had us a little on edge early on. Thankfully we hadn't paid anything upfront, so there was no risk if they'd disappeared. In the end they came through: no deposit required, and we paid in full only after the work was complete.

stages.name: Gunite

Gunite (shotcrete) sprayed to form the pool shell. The pool shape is now permanent.
 Second Draw Due

stages.name: Backfill
stages.description:
Backfilling around the pool shell with dirt and compaction. 
Backfill in pool construction refers to the process of filling the excavated area around a pool with soil or other materials after the pool is installed. This is essential for providing support, preventing moisture issues, and ensuring the stability of the pool structure.

stages.name: Fence Installation
stages.description: Installing fence around the backyard.  Not part of the pool process but we included it to surround the backyard.

stages.name: Pre-Grade, Rough Plumbing & Electric Day 1
stages.description:
Initial grading around the pool area. 
Grading in pool construction refers to leveling and shaping the ground to create a stable base for the pool, preventing issues like cracking or sinking. Proper grading also ensures water drains away from the pool area to avoid erosion and drainage problems. 

Above-ground rough plumbing lines and electrical wiring installed.
